rules.name: Spirit Vessel
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Spirit Vessel: Soul Release on an enemy cuts its health restoration by 70% and drains 4% of its current health per second for 8 s (10 s cooldown, charges from hero deaths within 1500). It is in his build (Urn of Shadows 70% at ~6 min, Spirit Vessel 57% at ~12 min of the won games).
